decisions.reason: As the market shifted from Universal Analytics to GA4, this plugin fits current client demand and the firm's existing e-commerce analytics capabilities, so it is likely to meet aspirations and be retained.

Because Universal Analytics was being phased out, this plugin would likely fall clearly below aspiration levels versus alternatives and comparable firms, making withdrawal the most plausible response.

A retail system interface plugin matches the firm's integration strengths and can support client lock-in across shop operations, so with some organizational slack it is likely to be kept despite niche-demand uncertainty.

SEO support for shop relaunches is tightly complementary to the firm's core project business and visible as a stand-alone offer, so it likely performs acceptably relative to aspirations and stays on the market.
